code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, pancytopenia (anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia), neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, mild eosinophilia, elevated creatinine, hyperkalemia, and low serum protein. These findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, impaired oxygenation, and early renal dysfunction. Urgent clinical evaluation is recommended to clarify underlying causes such as infection, hematologic disorder, or systemic disease.
